lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin, with the highest intensity maxima located in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance circular blobs, creating a structured grid pattern where the blobs serve as primary nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A horizontal linear ridge is visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with light values above and shadow below.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense, stochastic distribution of small high-luminance spots that contrasts with the regular grid pattern observed on the lateral flank.
